About
About Happy China Cafe

Located at 4001 S Sam Houston Pkwy E #135 in Houston, Texas, Happy China Cafe offers a delicious experience for those craving authentic Chinese cuisine. The restaurant is known for its consistently tasty food, which many patrons find to be a standout in the local area. Whether you're trying something new or enjoying a familiar favorite, the dishes here rarely disappoint. Many customers praise the food for its quality, noting that everything they've tried has been worth ordering again. Special mentions include the hot and flavorful Wonton Soup, and generous portions like the egg foo young, which often come with leftovers due to their ample servings.

Though Happy China Cafe once focused more on in-house dining, it adapted during the COVID-19 pandemic by shifting toward takeout services. This shift included serving meals in disposable dishes with plastic silverware, which some find a bit off-putting, but many still appreciate the overall quality and convenience of the meals. The restaurant has since resumed indoor dining, and customers who dine in enjoy the pleasant atmosphere and attentive service. The staff is often described as friendly and polite, with only a slight delay when needing to call for service, but they’re quick to respond once approached.

For those on a budget, Happy China Cafe’s lunch specials are often highlighted as a great value, providing good food at a reasonable price. The cafe's cleanliness and convenient location add to its appeal, making it an easy choice for anyone in the area. Whether you're grabbing a quick bite or sitting down to enjoy a meal, Happy China Cafe stands out for its consistent food quality, friendly service, and overall positive dining experience.

Reviews

“ I have dined in twice and ordered via delivery twice. Good service but a little slow. The food was good and taste fresh. When ordering this evening, my experience was not so great. I ordered the crispy shrimp walnut entree which was hit and miss with sauce on the mainly breaded shrimps not enough sauce especially on the bottom . NOTE: There plenty of walnuts pieces on the dish. Also,I ordered the crispy fish pieces which were good but the container was not ventilated to prevent moist fish. I think I will stick with the dine in experience and not do take out. Overall, I do like this food and restaurant. ”

Ms Tee

“ My food was served quickly and was pretty good, but I thought the meat was a little over cooked. That's usually not the case here. I'm rarely disappointed with the mostly excellent food. The Win Ton Soup was hot and very good! My friend had their ample egg foo young, half of which she took home with her. She seemed to enjoy it very much. The service was good, but we usually needed to call the waitress when we needed something. However, when we did, she took care of us immediately and is always friendly and polite. The place transitioned during Covid to mostly take out from previously focusing more on in house diners. So they serve everything in disposable dishes, with plastic silverware. However they have always been willing, since opening for indoor seating after Covid, to serve fine in customers. Their lunch specials are a real bargain, and the food is generally quite good. I'm sure I'll be back when I'm next in Pearland. ”

Dr Robert Cesario

“ The food was good, except I'm not sure why they are using disposable plates for a serving, though, so I'll give 4 star for that, instead of 5. ”

Jen Jen

“ The food here is absolutely delicious! I don't eat Chinese food from just anywhere, infact I'm skeptical about a lot of places. Everything I've tried here has been something I'd eat again. The cleanliness is top tier, convenient location and nice staff. ”

T. Chavis

“ It is a small place with very good and hot food. I've been visiting this place since a friend and I came to check it out. The food itself is great. They have a lunch special, which includes the main dish, a soup, and an egg roll. Of the choices of soup, they really need to improve on them. However I prefer the Wonton soup with sine chili oil mixed in. As for the lunch specials, they are all made to order so they are hot and delicious. Only things to point out are 1. The bottom 5 dishes of the lunch specials kind of taste the same. However, they are still good. 2. They use disposable everything, which is not great when your fork bends to the chispy food you're trying to eat, plus it's so much non biodegradable/nonrecyclable waste. 3. The service by Lin/Ling, is very attentive and checks on you ro make sure all is good. Overall, I will continue to visit this place and suggest you so too if you're close. ”

E Se
